name: Gulf Coast Bird Observatory Land Acquisition Fund grants
summary: Grants from an endowment fund to non-profit conservation groups buying native habitat for birds along the US Gulf Coast, from Florida to Texas. About one project is funded a year.

geography.label: Gulf Coast states, Florida to Texas

reporting: A report once the property is bought and secured by deed, and a progress report one year after purchase.

calls.label: Annual land acquisition request
calls.recurring: Requests are due by 1 April each year.

status.quote: We must receive your request by April 1st to be considered for funding in that calendar year.

recurring.quote: We must receive your request by April 1st to be considered for funding in that calendar year.

applicant_types.quote: Any proven non-profit NGO that operates in or with partners in a Gulf Coast state in the USA can apply.

geography.quote: Conservation land acquisition projects along the Gulf Coast in any of the gulf coast states from Florida to Texas are eligible.

access.quote: Fill in the outlined form below or follow a similar format to apply, and attach the required items.

window.quote: We must receive your request by April 1st to be considered for funding in that calendar year.

amount.quote: Most projects can receive between $15,000 and $40,000 (USD).

reporting.quote: A follow up report once property is bought and secured by deed, showing that you have bought the property.
